annotation.bound_parties_text: The Department of Business and Economic Development, the Department of Transportation (including the Maryland Aviation Administration), the Department of State Police, local law enforcement and local government officials are directed to act, and counties and municipalities are preempted from regulating unmanned aircraft systems.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The Department of Business and Economic Development and the Department of Transportation, including the Maryland Aviation Administration, shall:
annotation.dates_quote: That this Act shall take effect July 1, 2015.
